meta.description: Registry of minimal local theorems, propositions, and conjectures.

theorems.name: Projection Idempotence Under Stable Admissibility
theorems.statement: If admissibility conditions are stable and Pi_A maps into the admissible domain, then applying Pi_A twice is equivalent to applying it once within the declared equivalence relation.

theorems.name: Transport Identity on Null Path
theorems.statement: For an admissible identity transport path, NavT preserves the local orientation state up to declared residue equivalence.

theorems.name: Continuation Requires Non-Empty Admissible Image
theorems.statement: A continuation event exists only if the admissibility projection has a non-empty image for the target state under current residue and orientation constraints.
